correctness.rationale: Uniform layer initial data is invariant because each W_j preserves ones; resulting recursion equals an absorbing pure-birth chain with independent geometric waiting times. Exact binomial-tail reduction yields Gaussian CLT window and law-of-large-numbers delay at homogeneous coupling. Uniform third-moment bounds and variance comparable to depth yield Lyapunov CLT for nondegenerate heterogeneous bridges. Block triangularity gives the stated characteristic polynomial and a length-d Jordan block. For a single exceptional bridge, the remaining sojourns satisfy LLN and the bridge satisfies an exponential geometric scaling law, proving critical profile and iff depth*b1 tends to infinity. Standalone check.py, rerun using Python 3 stdlib, passed exact rational finite checks for depths 1–5, agents n=2,3, times 0–15. Finite checks are not asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: The natural gap in the motivating directed acyclic multiplex DeGroot system is how far source information travels by a finite time as topic hierarchy depth grows. Exact influence response gives an O(depth) delay, sharp O(sqrt depth) Gaussian window and topology-independent transient for unanimous layer inputs. The fixed nontrivial spectral radius yet depth-diverging delay pinpoints a genuine limitation of a common convergence proxy; the 1/depth single-bridge phase boundary identifies when a slow cross-topic link dominates overall propagation. This structural distinction supplies a concrete benchmark for hierarchical opinion systems. Assumptions and limits are explicit; no empirical significance is claimed.
